name: StreamingLLM
summary: A sliding window that also pins the first few tokens. Those "attention sinks" absorb attention no matter what they contain, and keeping four of them is most of the quality a cheap policy can recover.

source.title: Efficient Streaming Language Models with Attention Sinks
